sentences.text: This bail application is filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.666/2024 of Peerumade Police Station, Idukki registered for the offences punishable under sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1862 (for short IPC).
3.

According to the prosecution, the accused had on 28.12.2023 and again on 22.02.2024 committed rape on the defacto complainant promising to provide employment in Australia after asking her to appear for an interview and thereby committed the offences alleged.
4. Petitioner was arrested on 30.03.2025 and has been in custody since then.
5. I have heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.

6. The petitioner is alleged to have induced the defacto complainant to attend an interview and thereafter raped her during the fake interview and again repeated the same on another occasion also, he is 2025:KER:42280 alleged to have raped her.
Subsequently, the victim got pregnant and delivered a child.
The petitioner is alleged to be involved in similar crimes in Mumbai as well as in Nedumudi Police Station.
There is also another crime committed by the petitioner at the Kattapana Police Station under Section 420 of the IPC.
Having regard to the nature of the allegations and also the criminal antecedents against the petitioner, I am of the view that this is not a fit case to release the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, this bail application is dismissed.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE Cak 2025:KER:42280 APPENDIX OF BAIL APPL.
